scripts.build:production: pnpm --filter @artifactshare/contract build && WRANGLER_CONFIG_PATH=wrangler.production.jsonc WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=../../.wrangler/logs react-router build && node app/test/check-production-route-build.mjs
scripts.dev:og-image: WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=../../.wrangler/logs pnpm exec wrangler dev -c wrangler.og-image.jsonc --env-file ../../.dev.vars --port 5175 --local-protocol https --https-key-path ../../.dev-certs/key.pem --https-cert-path ../../.dev-certs/cert.pem --inspector-port 0
scripts.dev:sandbox: WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=../../.wrangler/logs pnpm exec wrangler dev -c wrangler.sandbox.jsonc --env-file ../../.dev.vars --port 5174 --local-protocol https --https-key-path ../../.dev-certs/key.pem --https-cert-path ../../.dev-certs/cert.pem --inspector-port 0
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @artifactshare/contract build && pnpm cf-typegen && ARTIFACTSHARE_INCLUDE_DEV_ROUTES=1 react-router typegen && tsc -b
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @artifactshare/contract build && PUBLIC_TEST=1 vitest --config vitest.config.ts --run && pnpm test:behavior-browser && pnpm test:visual-browser
scripts.test:visual-browser: pnpm --filter @artifactshare/contract build && cd ../.. && docker compose -f compose.playwright.yml run --rm visual
scripts.test:visual-browser:update: cd ../.. && docker compose -f compose.playwright.yml run --rm visual-update
scripts.db:apply:local: WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=../../.wrangler/logs pnpm exec wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local
scripts.db:apply:remote:production: WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=../../.wrangler/logs pnpm exec wrangler d1 migrations apply DB -c wrangler.production.jsonc --remote
scripts.build:alerts: WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=../../.wrangler/logs pnpm exec wrangler deploy -c wrangler.alerts.jsonc --dry-run --outdir ../../build/alerts
scripts.build:og-image: WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=../../.wrangler/logs pnpm exec wrangler deploy -c wrangler.og-image.jsonc --dry-run --outdir ../../build/og-image
scripts.build:sandbox: WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=../../.wrangler/logs pnpm exec wrangler deploy -c wrangler.sandbox.jsonc --dry-run --outdir ../../build/sandbox
scripts.build:alerts:production: WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=../../.wrangler/logs pnpm exec wrangler deploy -c wrangler.alerts.jsonc --env production --dry-run --outdir ../../build/alerts-production
scripts.build:og-image:production: WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=../../.wrangler/logs pnpm exec wrangler deploy -c wrangler.og-image.jsonc --env production --dry-run --outdir ../../build/og-image-production
scripts.build:sandbox:production: WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=../../.wrangler/logs pnpm exec wrangler deploy -c wrangler.sandbox.jsonc --env production --dry-run --outdir ../../build/sandbox-production
scripts.build:production:topology: pnpm build:production && pnpm build:alerts:production && pnpm build:og-image:production && pnpm build:sandbox:production
scripts.deploy:production:built: pnpm db:apply:remote:production && WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=../../.wrangler/logs pnpm exec wrangler deploy -c wrangler.alerts.jsonc --env production && WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=../../.wrangler/logs pnpm exec wrangler deploy -c wrangler.og-image.jsonc --env production && node ../../scripts/deploy-content-cutover.mjs
